slides.texte_overlay:
what i do in the 10 minutes
before a test starts

a few sips of water.
not a whole bottle.

i roll my shoulders and unclench my jaw.
i hadn't noticed how tense i was.

i lay out my pens and calculator.
everything i need, nothing else.

i read something short and unrelated.
a fun fact about space or a painting.
